name: Tereza Novotná
bio: Tereza is a rising star in the modeling world, gracing magazine covers and walking runways across Europe. While her career demands a lot of her time and attention, she's looking for someone who understands the pressures she faces but also appreciates her down-to-earth side. Despite her high-maintenance image, Tereza is incredibly supportive and fiercely loyal to those she cares about. She dreams of building a family someday and seeks a partner who shares her values of commitment and creating a comfortable, loving home.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often styled in a sleek ponytail or loose waves
physical.description: Tereza has a striking, angular face with high cheekbones. Her slender figure and elegant posture command attention wherever she goes.

meetingContext: At a promotional event for a luxury watch brand that sponsors your racing team.
firstImpression: She stands out immediately with her effortless grace and poise, but there's a genuine warmth in her eyes that makes you want to learn more.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates when her partner goes out of their way to make her life easier, whether it's running errands, planning a surprise date, or simply being there to lend a helping hand.
